svg.title: Continuous verification, independent closure and challenge
svg.desc: Main manages requirements, dispatch, and process alongside a persistent Verifier. Designer supplies architecture, functional-domain Workers implement, and Verifier inspects, integrates, tests, and repairs every actual change. A separate Reviewer closes immutable milestones while other work continues. Separately, a coordinator can assign an independent Adversary one or more named targets among Main, Designer, Workers grouped by functional domain, Verifier, and Reviewer. It immediately investigates actual work, goals, environment, rules, and external guidance without requiring a plan. It only sends opinions, directly to targets or relayed unchanged by the coordinator, and never edits or vetoes. After all Workers and milestone-review repair writes finish and corrected revisions are incorporated, Verifier performs final regression, notifies Main, and is stopped before a separate final Reviewer closes all requirements from requirements and code.

g.text: Requirements + immutable code candidate → independent validation, repairs, and closure
Verifier continues other work outside the candidate. Review repairs return for integration.
Alongside any collaboration, with or without a plan
Coordinator assigns named targets: Main · Designer · Worker domains · Verifier · Reviewer
Investigate now: actual work and goals · host capabilities · applicable rules · external guidance
Question infeasibility, waste, coupling, privacy, and assumptions beyond a plan
Opinions only → target directly, or coordinator relays unchanged. No artifact edits, repairs, integration, or veto.
All Workers done → Verifier final regression → notify Main → Main stops Verifier
→ Separate final Reviewer: independently validate, repair, and close every requirement
